items.observation: _grid is `late final` and built with the initial connectionDistance value; didUpdateWidget looks only at particleCount. If connectionDistance grows at runtime the cells stay smaller than the link distance: particle pairs two cells apart are no longer found, while the painter uses the new distance, and lines come out missing. A seed change also does not reposition the particles. No test changes these parameters at runtime.
items.proposed_fix: In didUpdateWidget rebuild the grid when connectionDistance changes (drop the late final); restart the particles when seed changes. Test: increase the distance and compare the drawn line count against an all-pairs reference (red first).
items.closure_criteria: didUpdateWidget rebuilds the spatial grid when connectionDistance changes and restarts the particles when seed changes. A test that increases the distance at runtime matches the all-pairs reference line count.

items.observation: The static Paint objects and the static glow cache (_cachedGlowColor, _cachedGlowStops) in _ConstellationPainter are shared across all instances. If two regions of different color are on screen the cache is recomputed every frame.
items.proposed_fix: Move the Paint objects and the cache onto the state instance and pass them to the painter as parameters. There must still be no per-frame allocation.
items.closure_criteria: The Paint objects and the glow cache live on the state instance and reach the painter as parameters, with no per-frame allocation.

items.kind: duplicate logic / check measuring the wrong target
items.observation: The script carries a copy of _SpatialGrid (its doc says 'identical to the one in lib'). The all-pairs/grid agreement check in CI measures this copy, not the class shipped with the package. If the grid in lib changes, the check silently goes stale.
items.proposed_fix: Move the grid into lib/src/spatial_grid.dart, free of any Flutter dependency (without exporting it). Let both lib and the script import it and delete the copy. This means splitting the file; it must follow CP-01.
items.closure_criteria: One grid implementation in lib/src/spatial_grid.dart serves both the widget and example/frame_cost.dart, and the copied _SpatialGrid is deleted. The CI all-pairs agreement check runs against the shipped grid.

items.observation: The 100000 multiplier in the cell key is written as a literal in two places. getNearby does not use the _key function. The assumption that the key stays collision-free only while cy < 100000 is not written anywhere.
items.proposed_fix: A single _keyOf(cx, cy) function, a named constant, and a one-line doc stating the assumption.
items.closure_criteria: A single _keyOf helper with a named 100000 constant serves both key sites and getNearby. A one-line doc states the collision assumption below cy 100000.

items.observation: The initial speed 0.4, the push multiplier 0.02, the opacities (0.6, 0.08, 0.15, 0.05), the line width 0.5, the glow threshold 1.2 and the ×4 multiplier are bare literals.
items.proposed_fix: Define private _k constants with a one-line meaning note for each. Behavior does not change.
items.closure_criteria: Each listed literal becomes a private _k constant with a one-line meaning note. The visible behavior is unchanged.

items.observation: Motion advances per frame, not by elapsed time. Drift on a 120 Hz screen is therefore twice as fast as on 60 Hz. AnimationController is used only as a frame clock; the 1 second duration value carries no meaning.
items.proposed_fix: Derive dt from the ticker elapsed time and calibrate to 60 fps; test with fake time. The visible behavior changes and a minor release plus a CHANGELOG entry are required.
items.closure_criteria: Motion advances by dt derived from the ticker elapsed time, calibrated to 60 fps, and a fake-time test covers it. A minor release and a CHANGELOG entry ship the change.

items.kind: hook leaked into lib for tests
items.observation: A getter marked @visibleForTesting was added to the private State; the test reaches it through dynamic and this loses type checking.
items.proposed_fix: Tie the test to observable output (particle positions or the painted result) and remove the getter.
items.closure_criteria: The @visibleForTesting getter is gone and test/touch_reactive_test.dart asserts on observable output such as particle positions or the painted result.

items.observation: The public constructor has no `///` doc.
items.closure_criteria: The public constructor carries a one-sentence /// doc.

items.observation: material.dart is imported only for Colors.transparent.
items.proposed_fix: Use Color(0x00000000) and lower the import to widgets.dart.
items.closure_criteria: Colors.transparent is replaced by Color(0x00000000) and the import drops to widgets.dart.

items.observation: The 4 cases in example/test/hold_still_test.dart do not run in CI, while AGENTS.md says 'cd example && flutter test'. The base flutter >=3.24.0 is not tested either.
items.proposed_fix: Add a test step for example and put 3.24.0 in the matrix.
items.closure_criteria: CI runs the example tests including hold_still_test.dart and lists Flutter 3.24.0 in the matrix.
